overloadcore.lore: Rated power is only a suggestion.
overloadcore.warning: Cannot be removed in survival. Kept on death.
overloadcore.effects: Affects owned/shared Mek devices within %s blocks.
overloadcore.equip_hint: Hold the pendant in your hand and use it for two seconds to equip.
overloadcore.details_hint: Hold Shift to view curses and benefits.
overloadcore.hold_bind: Keep holding use for two seconds to permanently equip the core.
overloadcore.no_slot: An empty Core accessory slot is required.
overloadcore.foreign_core: This core is bound to another wearer.
overloadcore.not_owner: Aim at a device you own.
death.attack.overloadcore.electric: %1$s was struck down by a short circuit
overloadcore.curse.0: Cannot be removed in survival; kept on death.
overloadcore.curse.1: Machines use twice as much power while working.
overloadcore.curse.2: Generators produce half as much energy.
overloadcore.curse.3: Nearby working machines shock and repel you.
overloadcore.curse.4: Affected pipes transport at half speed.
overloadcore.curse.5: Machines sound louder; prolonged exposure causes nausea.
overloadcore.curse.6: Cannot sprint while carrying %s ingots worth of metal.
overloadcore.curse.7: Heat sources raise body heat; overheating causes damage.
overloadcore.gift.0: Double outputs for selected ore and component recipes.
overloadcore.gift.1: Recover 25% of the extra power to charge carried gear.
overloadcore.gift.3: %s: show nearby device locations and status.
